items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Week 7; McVay says minor but will test pregame after limited/DNP Friday. Status crucial for Rams offense with Adams already OUT.
items.why: Calf tightness felt mid-practice Thursday; no full explosion; game-time decision.
items.implication: If OUT, heavy TE usage (Higbee primary) and remaining WRs; Stafford volume shifts.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike to ~37% historical when Puka out; multi-TE sets.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle) vs Bengals; Ravens list official Q. Early news critical for DFS slate.
items.why: Ankle issue; progressive but not cleared fully.
items.implication: If OUT, major downgrade to Ravens pass catchers and Henry script change; backup QB impact.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) vs MIA; status key. Berry notes if active start him.
items.implication: If active, immediate RB1 upside vs soft MIA; if OUT, Allen/Braelon elevate.

items.text: Official OUTs include Brian Robinson, Zach Charbonnet, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Davante Adams (plus others). ETR aligns fully.
items.implication: Clear paths for backups/handcuffs and teammate volume spikes; Bijan full vs SF DvP with BRob out.
items.opportunity: Bijan elevated carries/targets; Walker full SEA backfield; Judkins/IN backs; TE streams where Warren out.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel ruled OUT for 49ers vs ATL (Evans Achilles confirm by Shanahan/Rapoport). Matches ETR dump.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; massive funnel to Kittle and CMC (slot looks).
items.opportunity: Kittle WR-out target monopoly; CMC more receiving snaps/routes.

items.text: IN: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson (plus others). Jacobs cleared facility activities earlier.
items.why: Cleared or expected to play; Jacobs non-football activities noted prior.
items.implication: Jacobs RB2/flex viable but rusty post-layoff (Berry hates workload Q); Judkins opportunity; Addison WR3 boom.
items.opportunity: Immediate snaps for returners; reverse prior handcuff elevation.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs @ DET due to layoff/role questions.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected back Week 7 vs DAL; if active, right back in lineups (Stephania agrees). Efficient in prior games; DAL soft vs RBs. Rank ~RB15.
items.why: Return timeline met; matchup + efficiency history.
items.implication: Must-start RB if cleared; immediate volume.
items.opportunity: Full backfield lead vs favorable DAL.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. Adams already long-term OUT.
items.why: McVay comments on lack of power/explosion; historical TE share 37% without Puka.
items.implication: TE-heavy game script; Higbee primary beneficiary for volume.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to TEs and remaining WRs; multi-TE personnel.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT creates really sweet setup for Bijan Robinson vs SF. 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches conceded (White, Holani, Harvey, Love).
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT; SF soft vs RB receiving/production.
items.implication: Bijan full opportunity + favorable DvP for RB1 ceiling.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries, targets, red-zone with no BRob competition and soft matchup.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts vs ATL: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). CMC tempted for more slot looks amid WR injuries (rare buy on RB-as-WR).
items.why: WR outs create funnel; CMC smile on slot question; Kaelon Black presence.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1 lock; CMC receiving upside boost beyond usual.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets monopoly; CMC slot snaps/routes in two-minute/red-zone.
items.conflict: Rarely buys RB-as-WR narrative but exception here.

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes; Cole Kmet IR (season-ending knee) may reduce 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice. Loveland already 30% ts/19.2 PPR with Caleb.
items.why: Kmet serious knee to IR (Rapoport/Schefter/Johnson confirm season-ending); Burden efficiency + route rate room.
items.implication: Burden WR upside spike; Loveland TE1 lock post-Caleb return.
items.opportunity: Higher route rate/target share for Burden; Loveland sustained 30% ts.

items.text: LOVE Colston Loveland (30% ts, 19.2 PPR, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games w/ Caleb). LOVE AJ Brown (97% routes, 33% ts despite drops; buy). LOVE Jaylen Warren (workload + soft NO). Also DeVonta, Kraft, Golden, Hubbard, Irving.
items.why: Usage (Loveland ts/routes post-Caleb; AJB routes/ts; Warren volume) + matchups (Lions TE buffet, Bears yards, NO vs RBs).
items.opportunity: Sustained high target/route/carry shares in plus spots.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks. Not like this for the rookie.
items.why: Persistent low snap share despite opportunity.
items.implication: Avoid or bench; limited role in NE backfield.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze (vs Gonzalez shadow, low ceiling), Josh Downs (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough SEA), Josh Jacobs (layoff workload Q @ DET). Also Mahomes.
items.why: Nasty matchups (Odunze/Kelce), role/volume issues (Downs), rust/workload (Jacobs post-absence).
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan note Jacobs IN but Berry cautious on immediate value.
